findings.evidence: Couplings.lean:234-238 `simp only [smTreeLevelCouplings, ofQuantumNumbers, ..., mk.injEq, and_true]` then `refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> ring`; existing consumers project single species: Parameters.lean:302-312 `(smTreeLevelCouplings s2).electron.gA`, `.upType.gV`, `.downType.gV`, and Parameters.lean:332-337 `.electron.gV`.
findings.fix: Extract `smTreeLevelCouplings_electron_eq_ofQuantumNumbers`, `_upType_...`, `_downType_...` (each `(smTreeLevelCouplings s2).electron = ofQuantumNumbers (isospinWeight 1) (doubletElectricCharge standardModel.YL 1) s2`, proved by `simp only [smTreeLevelCouplings, ofQuantumNumbers, ...]` + `ring_nf`/`norm_num`), then derive the record equality from the three by rewriting instead of re-deriving the arithmetic behind a flattened conjunction.
findings.issue: `smTreeLevelCouplings_eq_ofQuantumNumbers` folds three independent per-species computations into one record equality, proved by unfolding `smTreeLevelCouplings` and `ofQuantumNumbers` and then depending on the exact conjunction shape simp leaves (`NeutralCurrentCouplings.mk.injEq`, `FermionNeutralCurrentCouplings.mk.injEq`, `and_true`) for `refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> ring`. The reusable facts — the electron, up and down identities — are not available separately, and the proof bypasses the `ofQuantumNumbers_gV`/`_gA` API it just established.

findings.evidence: Parameters.lean:86-92; the two `simpa` goals after `obtain ⟨cV, cA⟩ := c` are `{gV := cV, gA := cA}.gL + ... .gR = ...`, resolved via the `@[simp]` lemmas at Parameters.lean:72-81.
findings.fix: Make the arithmetic explicit: `simp only [gL_def, gR_def] at hL hR; simp only [mk.injEq]; constructor <;> linarith` (or tag `FermionNeutralCurrentCouplings` `@[ext]` and finish with `ext <;> linarith`), so the proof does not depend on the orientation or simp-tagging of `gL_add_gR`/`gL_sub_gR`.
findings.issue: `ext_gL_gR` proves `cV = dV` and `cA = dA` by `simpa using congrArg₂ (· + ·) hL hR` / `congrArg₂ (· - ·) hL hR`. The step is closed only because `gL_add_gR`/`gL_sub_gR` are `@[simp]` and simp additionally iota-reduces the destructured constructor projections; nothing in the script says that adding and subtracting the hypotheses recovers the two fields, and the proof breaks opaquely if either simp lemma is re-oriented or untagged.

summary: Proofs are mostly robust (norm_num/ring over named-rewrite chains, no change/show, no overlong proofs), but the main acceptance theorem hides three reusable per-species identities inside one record equality proved through a simp-normal-form-dependent conjunction, and ext_gL_gR closes its two subgoals by an opaque congrArg₂ + simpa trick.
